guide.h2: Choosing a removal company in Leeds
p: Moving house is one of the few times you hand everything you own to strangers, so it pays to check the firm. A good removal company will survey your home first, give a written fixed price and explain its insurance. Be wary of very low phone quotes: some firms add charges on the day for extra items, stairs or parking.
Leeds has plenty of terraced streets, student areas and city centre flats where parking a removal lorry is hard. Ask whether the firm needs a parking suspension and who arranges it.

ul: Standard removal: a crew and a van load, move and unload your belongings.
Packing service: the crew packs for you, usually the day before, and often supplies boxes.
Dismantling and assembly: beds, wardrobes and tables taken apart and rebuilt.
Storage: containers in a warehouse for a gap between moves.
Man and van: cheaper for a flat or a few items, but usually with less insurance cover.

guide.h2: How much do removals cost in Leeds?
p: Checkatrade's 2026 guide puts a team of two with a van at £50 to £80 an hour, with a typical move costing £500 to £700. By house size it gives an average total, including packing, of about £925 for a 2 bedroom house, £1,300 for a 3 bedroom house and £1,800 for a 4 bedroom house. See our removals cost guide for more.

ul: Book early for Fridays, the end of the month and late summer, which are the busiest times.
Declutter before the survey so you are not paying to move things you will throw away. Our rubbish removal in Leeds list can help.
Label boxes by room and keep a box of essentials with you.
Check what your contents insurance covers during the move.

guide.h2: Questions to ask a removal company
ul: Is the quote fixed, and what could change it?
What insurance covers my goods, and what is the limit per item?
Are you a BAR member, and how do I complain if something goes wrong?
Will the same crew pack and move?
Do you need a parking suspension at either address?

faqs.q: How much does it cost to move a 3 bedroom house?
faqs.a: Checkatrade's 2026 guide gives an average of about £1,300 including packing, or about £900 for the removal alone. MyBuilder puts a full service move for a 3 bedroom house at £1,200 to £1,700.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book removals?
faqs.a: Four to six weeks is sensible, and longer for a Friday or end of month move. Many firms will pencil in a date before you have a completion date.

faqs.q: Are my belongings insured during a move?
faqs.a: Most removal firms include some goods in transit insurance, but the cover and limits vary. Ask for the details in writing, and check your own contents policy.

faqs.q: What is the British Association of Removers?
faqs.a: BAR is the trade association for UK removal firms. Members follow a code of practice and offer an independent dispute resolution scheme if something goes wrong.
